title: Choir in the Compressor
caption: Destroyed gospel, with no drums at all. An electric guitar chord is gated, clipped and chopped into huge stuttering blocks of white-hot distortion that slam on and off in rhythm, with total silence between them. Over that, two clear unprocessed voices, a man and a woman, sing a simple slow hymn in close harmony, untouched by the noise. The contrast is the point: pristine voices, annihilated instrument. Stark, bright, ecstatic, overwhelming.
